reason: I'd have to drive out to Bexleyheath or Gillingham to look at them and collect, and I can only do that by taking time off from the daily commute. Plus I'd just haggle down a used set on Marketplace nearer to me for well under £240.
objection: I do not want to travel to collect. A new seller with no reviews, and £240 is a lot when I can find decent secondhand sets for £120-150 and knock more off.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery or collection close to me, and a price nearer £160-180 for my exact fitment.
